findings.title: Target is not a git repository
findings.reason: Without git metadata the auditor cannot distinguish tracked from untracked files, and cannot examine history for secrets or removed files.  The scan falls back to walking the filesystem, which includes local build output.
findings.recommendation: Run the audit against a git checkout of what will be published.

limitations: Only git-tracked files were examined.  Untracked working-tree files -- including any local .env holding live credentials -- were not scanned.  Re-run with scan.include_untracked=true to cover them.
